entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6113920619134019456: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.0170 +/- 0.0182 mas (same row, RUWE 0.87): 124.73 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -28.907, -22.248 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.38 +/- 0.06 solar radii from Barber et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HIP 67522 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJ...973L..30B/abstract). Mass 1.22 +/- 0.05 solar masses from Barber et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HIP 67522 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJ...973L..30B/abstract). Temperature 5675 +/- 75 K from Barber et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HIP 67522 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,675 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 120411 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffefe7. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 120411 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,675 K and log g 4.24 (u1 0.478, u2 0.248): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
